notes: CANDIDATE 2026-11-13, the living room's clock (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "I don't want a plain black one though", then "I want 2 diferent clocks for living room / dining"). Placement: the living room's upper-left corner, on the window wall between the stair railing and the window, 48 in from the corner, 60 in to its center (F-70). Why: legible (F-70): a white face with tall, plain, bold black Arabic numerals and black hands; a different design from the dining room's round walnut AKCISOT (amazon-B0GX5LPNPJ): square, in an antique gold that sits with the brass door knobs and the Decofy's Champagne Bronze knobs (F-68), 16 in for the 11 to 14 ft from the sofa, the chaise and the stairs. Read 2026-11-13: $57.99, 4.4 stars (516), Antique Hamilton Gold (also Modern Silver B0BBG4FTX1, Oil Rubbed Bronze B0CYP7BX85, Light Gray Oak B0BBG3YT43; a 10 inch, B08CK2KLD6), 16 x 16 in, 4.34 lb, ABS case, "Quiet Sweeping Quartz Movement", 1 AA. Glass: "has high grade glass lens"; whether it comes out is not documented, and its reviews page filtered for "glass" hit Amazon's bot check, not touched. F-21 says no glass, so the lens is Andrew's call (asked 2026-11-13). Flags: assumed-position:window. rooms: the brief.
